newsitem.title: HONG KONG: DKB unit Chekiang First Bank FRCD raised.
newsitem.headline: DKB unit Chekiang First Bank FRCD raised.

text.p: Hong Kong-based Chekiang First Bank's five-year floating rate certificates of deposit issue has been increased to HK$550 million from HK$500 million due to oversubscription, arranger Commerz (East Asia) said.
The borrower is wholly-owned by Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank.
The certificates were priced at par to float at 50 basis points over the three-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate. There are put and call options in year three and four.
With fees, the all-in returns for top-tier manager is 63 basis points.
Arrangers, with HK$65 million each, are Commerz (East Asia), DKB Asia and Schroders Asia.

Co-lead managers are Dresdner Bank's Hong Kong branch, with HK$55 million, and Banca Commerciale Italiana's Hong Kong branch, Bank Austria's Hong Kong branch, Fuji International Finance (HK), Jardine Fleming Bank, JP Morgan Securities Asia, Royal Bank of Scotland and Westdeutsche Landesbank, with HK$30 million each.
Managers are Banca di Roma and Dah Sing Bank, with HK$25 million each, and BW Bank Ireland plc and PT Bank Pembangunan Indonesia (Persero), with HK$20 million each.
Payment date is December 16. -- HK Newsroom (852) 2843 6960
